name: @profile-as-code/cli
description: pasco — the profile-as-code CLI (M1): init, validate, build, diff + explicit stubs (refine/check/skills:install). Consumes @profile-as-code/core; never re-implements load/drift/geo/compile.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/core build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/markdown build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/renderers-github-readme build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/renderers-github-org build && tsup && node -e "process.platform !== 'win32' && require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/index.js', 0o755)"
